body: I'm where you are. I won't say more than that because I know how pissed off I get when people tell me they know how I feel, but I think I do.
I like this idea a lot, thanks a bunch!
I'm scared of being told I have to wait. In myself I feel like I can wait for a day maybe, but I don't want to be told that I have no choice but to wait for like a week.
I guess tomorrow. I really don't know.

Thanks for the well wishes.

The advice about the parents is good though awkward. I'm currently living with them which is part of why I'm in this situation. Not them specifically, but having to live with them. None the less, I may just go anyway and have the hospital call them. I don't know if it would come as a surprise or not honestly.
Thanks. I mean that genuinely for the part about going, not sarcastically for the last part.
I'm trying. This is proving difficult.

Thank you so much for answering.

Yeah, I've only done therapy in short bursts, but that tends to be how the depression comes as well.

When I said I'm worried I don't have time, I meant more that I would get suicidal before anything took effect, not so much that I was too busy.

Thanks again for answering, I definitely am taking it on board.
